title: युद्ध कथामा पहिचान, प्रतिनिधित्व र प्रतिरोध चेतना (Identity, Representation and Resistance Consciousness in the story 'War')
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेखमा कथाकार माया ठकुरीद्वारा रचित ‘युद्ध’ कथालाई पहिचान, प्रतिनिधित्व तथा प्रतिरोधको आधारमा विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । यस लेखमा तथ्य विश्लेषण गर्न सांस्कृतिक अध्ययनका विविध पक्षमध्येमा पहिचान, प्रतिनिधित्व र प्रतिरोध चेतनासम्बन्धी मान्यतालाई सैद्धान्तिक आधारका रूपमा ग्रहण गरिएको छ । लैङ्गिक दृष्टिले भिन्न पहिचान भएका महिला पात्रको प्रतिनिधित्व र लैङ्गिक आधारमा गरिने प्रतिरोध चेतना कसरी प्रस्तुत भएको छ भन्ने प्रश्नका आधारमा कथाको विश्लेषण गर्नु यस लेखनको उद्देश्य रहेको छ । पुस्तकालीय विधिबाट सङ्कलित शाब्दिक सामग्रीलाई आधार मानेर लेखिएको गुणात्मक प्रकृतिको यस लेखमा ‘युद्ध’ कथामा रहेको नारी पात्रको सामाजिक अवस्था, शोषणसम्बन्धी चेतना र त्यसको प्रतिकारको आवाजको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । ‘युद्ध’ कथामा रहेको कथ्यले समाजमा पितृसत्ता र यसको वर्चश्व जोगाउनका लागि पुरुषले गरेको हदैसम्मको निकृष्ट सोच र व्यवहारलाई समेटेको छ । यस कथामा रहेका महिला पात्रमाथि सामाजिक तथा पारिवारिक रूपले विभेद र शोषणको अवस्था र त्यसैमा रहेको महिला पात्रको पहिचानको चित्रण गरेको छ । कथकी नारी पात्रले समाजमा नारीलाई भोग्या र खेलौना ठान्ने प्रवृत्तिको विरोध मात्र गरेकी छैन, यस्तो प्रवृत्तिको खुलेर प्रतिरोध गरेकी छे र पुरुष समाजका घृणित व्यवहारको भन्डाफोर गर्न युद्ध नै छेडेकी छे । समाजको पितृसत्ताले बनाएका नियमहरू र समाजमा सन्तानको चाहना र यसका लागि गरिएको घृणित प्रपन्चका विरोधमा प्रतिकारमा उत्रिएकी नारी पात्रको लैङ्गिक पहिचान भिन्न प्रकारको र उसको सचेत बौद्धिक चेतना र सोहीअनुसारका सुझबुझपूर्ण गतिविधिले उसले शाहसी महिलाको प्रतिनिधित्व गरेको स्पष्ट हुन्छ । अतः ‘युद्ध’ कथामा समाजका यस्ता लैंगिक दृष्टिले हुने विसङ्गत र निन्दनीय सोच र कार्यको विरोधमा सचेत र सशक्त प्रतिरोध देखापर्छ । (In this article, the story 'Yuddh' written by storywriter Maya Thakuri has been analyzed on the basis of identity, representation and resistance. To analyze the facts, among the various aspects of cultural studies; the recognition of identity, representation and resistance consciousness has been adopted as a theoretical basis in the article. The purpose of this article is to analyze the story on the basis of the representation of female characters with different gender identities and the question of how the consciousness of resistance based on gender is presented. The article has been written based on the textual material collected from the library method. The social condition of the female character in the story 'Yuddha', the awareness of exploitation and the voice of resistance to it are analyzed in qualititative design. The narrative in the story 'Yuddha' covers the inferior thinking and behavior done by men to preserve the patriarchy and its dominance in the society. The social and familial forms of discrimination and exploitation of the female characters in this story and the identity of the female characters in it are depicted. The female character of the story not only opposed the trend of treating women as slaves and toys in the society, she openly resisted this trend and waged a war to destroy the disgusting behavior of the male society. It is clear that she represents a royal woman with a different type of gender identity with her conscious intellectual awareness and sensible activities. Therefore, in the story 'Yuddha', there is a conscious and strong resistance against such inconsistent and reprehensible thoughts and actions of the society based on gender.)
american_english: In the present article, the story "Yuddh" written by the storyteller Maya Thakuri has been analyzed on the basis of identity, representation, and resistance. In this article, in order to analyze the facts, the belief concerning identity, representation, and resistance consciousness—among the various aspects of cultural studies—has been taken as the theoretical basis. The purpose of this writing has been to analyze the story on the basis of the question of how the representation of the female character, who has a different gender identity, and the resistance consciousness carried out on a gender basis have been presented. Relying on the verbal material gathered through the library method, this article—qualitative in nature—has analyzed the social condition of the female character in the story "Yuddh", the consciousness related to exploitation, and the voice of resistance to it. The narrative contained in the story "Yuddh" has encompassed the extreme thinking and behavior that men have carried out to the fullest extent in order to preserve patriarchy in society and its dominance. In this story, the condition of discrimination and exploitation imposed on the female characters in social and family terms, and the identity of the female character located in it, have been portrayed. The woman character in the story has not only opposed the tendency in society to treat women as objects of pleasure and toys; she has openly resisted such a tendency and has taken up war herself to expose the hateful behavior of the male society. It becomes clear that the gender identity of the female character, who rises up in resistance against the rules made by society's patriarchy and against the hateful propaganda done for the desire for a son in society, is of a different kind, and that through her conscious intellectual awareness and the sensible activity carried out accordingly, she represents a heroic woman. Therefore, in the story "Yuddh", a conscious and strong resistance appears against the absurd and condemnable thinking and action of society that arises from such a gender viewpoint.

The purpose of this piece of writing has been to analyse the story on the basis of the question of how the representation of the female character with a different gender identity, and the resistance consciousness enacted on a gender basis, have been presented. On the basis of the verbal material collected by the library method, this article, which is qualitative in nature, has analysed the female character's social condition in the story "Yuddh", the consciousness connected with exploitation, and the voice of resistance to it. The narrative in the story "Yuddh" has encompassed the most extreme thinking and behaviour that men have exercised to the very limit in order to preserve patriarchy in society and its dominance. In this story, the state of discrimination and exploitation visited upon the female characters in social and familial terms, and the identity of the female character situated therein, have been depicted. The female protagonist of the story has not merely opposed the tendency in society to regard women as objects of enjoyment and toys; she has openly resisted such a tendency and has waged war to lay bare the loathsome behaviour of the male society. Therefore, in the story "Yuddh", a conscious and powerful resistance is shown against the absurd and blameworthy thinking and action of society that stems from such a gender viewpoint.

To get at the facts, the idea of identity, representation and resistance consciousness—sitting among the various strands of cultural studies—has been taken up as the theoretical basis of the article. What this writing sets out to do is analyse the story on the basis of the question of how the representation of the female character with a different gender identity, and the resistance consciousness carried out on a gender basis, have been presented. Built on the verbal material collected through the library method, this article is qualitative in nature, and it analyses the social situation of the female character in the story "Yuddh", the consciousness tied to exploitation, and the voice of resistance against it. The narrative in "Yuddh" has wrapped up the extreme thinking and behaviour men have used to the very limit in order to keep patriarchy in society and its dominance going. In this story, the discrimination and exploitation laid on the female characters in social and family terms, and the female character's identity sitting in that, have been portrayed. The woman at the centre of the story has not just pushed back against the tendency in society to treat women as objects of pleasure and playthings; she has resisted it openly and taken up war herself to lay bare the despicable behaviour of the male society. It is clear that the gender identity of the female character, who rises in resistance to the rules made by society's patriarchy and to the hateful propaganda done for the longing for a son in society, is of a different kind, and that, with her conscious intellectual awareness and the sensible activity that follows it, she represents a heroic woman. So, in the story "Yuddh", a conscious and forceful resistance shows up against the absurd and condemnable thinking and doing of society that come out of such a gender viewpoint.
informal_english: This article takes a look at "Yuddh", a story by storyteller Maya Thakuri, through the lens of identity, representation and resistance. To sort out the facts, it borrows the idea of identity, representation and resistance consciousness from the different sides of cultural studies and uses that as its theoretical base. What it's really after is analysing the story by asking how the female character, who has a different gender identity, gets represented, and how resistance consciousness on a gender basis gets shown. It's a qualitative piece built on written material pulled together with the library method, and it looks at the social situation of the woman in "Yuddh", the awareness tied to exploitation, and the voice of resistance against it. The story's narrative covers the most extreme thinking and behaviour men have gone to in order to keep patriarchy and its dominance alive in society. In this story, the discrimination and exploitation dumped on the female characters in social and family terms, and the female character's identity sitting in all that, get portrayed. The woman in the story hasn't just pushed back against the tendency to treat women as objects of pleasure and playthings; she's resisted it out in the open and taken up war herself to blow the cover on the despicable behaviour of the male society. It's clear that the gender identity of the female character, who rises up in resistance to the rules made by society's patriarchy and to the hateful propaganda done for the longing for a son in society, is a different kind of thing, and that with her conscious intellectual awareness and the sensible activity that goes with it, she represents a heroic woman. So, in "Yuddh", you see a conscious and strong resistance standing up against the absurd and condemnable thinking and doing of society that come out of such a gender viewpoint.
